import sqlite3 import unittest from src.database import DatabaseRepository class TestDatabaseRepository(unittest.TestCase): def setUp(self) -> None: """Инициализация изолированной in-memory базы перед каждым тестом.""" self.repo = DatabaseRepository(":memory:") # --- Тесты add --- def test_add_success(self) -> None: result = self.repo.add(1, "alex_dev", "

Hello world!

") self.assertTrue(result) record = self.repo.get_by_id(1) self.assertIsNotNone(record) self.assertEqual(record["name"], "alex_dev") def test_add_duplicate_id_raises_integrity_error(self) -> None: self.repo.add(1, "first_user", "First text") with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.IntegrityError): self.repo.add(1, "second_user", "Duplicate ID text") def test_add_validation_exceed_limits(self) -> None: long_name = "a" * 257 with self.assertRaises(ValueError): self.repo.add(2, long_name, "valid message") # --- Тесты get_by_id --- def test_get_by_id_exists(self) -> None: self.repo.add(42, "bot", "System alert") record = self.repo.get_by_id(42) self.assertEqual(record["id"], 42) self.assertEqual(record["message"], "System alert") def test_get_by_id_not_found(self) -> None: record = self.repo.get_by_id(9999) self.assertIsNone(record) # --- Тесты get_by_name --- def test_get_by_name_returns_all_matches(self) -> None: self.repo.add(10, "coder", "First message") self.repo.add(11, "other_user", "Irrelevant") self.repo.add(12, "coder", "Second message") records = self.repo.get_by_name("coder") self.assertEqual(len(records), 2) self.assertEqual([r["id"] for r in records], [10, 12]) def test_get_by_name_empty_list_for_unknown_user(self) -> None: records = self.repo.get_by_name("ghost_user") self.assertEqual(records, []) # --- Тесты update --- def test_update_success(self) -> None: self.repo.add(1, "editor", "Old message text") updated = self.repo.update(1, "New text content") self.assertTrue(updated) record = self.repo.get_by_id(1) self.assertEqual(record["message"], "New text content") def test_update_non_existent_id_raises_key_error(self) -> None: with self.assertRaises(KeyError): self.repo.update(404, "Can not update this") # --- Тесты delete --- def test_delete_success(self) -> None: self.repo.add(5, "temp_user", "To be deleted") deleted = self.repo.delete(5) self.assertTrue(deleted) self.assertIsNone(self.repo.get_by_id(5)) def test_delete_non_existent_id_returns_false(self) -> None: deleted = self.repo.delete(999) self.assertFalse(deleted) if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()
